newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end lower after early rally fizzles.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end lower after early rally fizzles.

text.p: Tokyo stocks finished with slight losses on Wednesday, as profit-taking and arbitrage-linked selling erased early morning gains inspired by the Dow industrial's surge to an all-time high overnight, brokers said.
The Nikkei 225 slipped 26.51 points or 0.13 percent to end at 20,130.51. September Nikkei futures ended down 50 at 20,130.

"Tokyo stocks were lifted initially by Wall Street, but they made little headway and disappointed investors started taking profits," said Masaaki Higashida, a Nomura Securities strategist. "But there were few factors to prompt a sell-off and the downside was limited, helped by bargain hunters."
